program.name: Long Engine
program.subject: Conditioning
program.blurb: Long conditioning days: a circuit then an AMRAP, or an EMOM then Tabatas.
program.about: Conditioning with time to build. One day is a long full-body circuit of lifts and cardio, then an AMRAP to finish; the other is an EMOM of the same kinds of moves, a set at the top of every minute, then two Tabatas. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II adds reps and Level III moves you one weight up.
program.split: Long circuit & AMRAP / long EMOM & Tabata
